text:
maya: Quick heads-up — urgent hotpatch today for a customer-facing KV cache bug. Planning a minimal diff; want to coordinate cutoff and rollouts. Target bump 1.11.2 -> 1.11.3.
alex: ACK. can review the tiny CRs. do we need a changelog entry?
maya: yes, small changelog + one-line release note. changelog proposed: 'fix(kv-cache): avoid double-free on short sequences'
sam: I'll run a focused smoke and latency check in staging once branch is up.
jin: I can create the hotfix branch and open a PR. will wait for final changelog phrasing.
release-bot: :robot_face: Release pipeline available. Use `hotfix/` prefix to trigger the hotpatch flow.
maya: Plan: cutoff in 30m unless major objections. Branch name: `hotfix/kv-shortseq-1.11.3`. No DB migrations, canary-only then gradual rollout.
alex: tiny wording nit for changelog: 'fix(kv-cache): prevent double-free on short sequences' — clearer.
maya: updated. thanks.
sam: quick question — do we need a special quantization tag or just the normal image?
ops_lead: normal image. ensure canary uses the same model bundle as prod. no topology changes.
jin: creating branch and PR now...
jin: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/hotfix/pull/1348 — includes changelog bump + single hunks. CI queued.
alex: will review PR now.
release-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: CI started for PR #1348 (build 211).
alex: small code snippet in PR looks fine, but handle nil pointer in route lookup:```go
if ctx.KV == nil {
  return nil
}
```
sam: I can run the staging smoke after CI passes. planning to check error rate and p95 token latency.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: CI passed for PR #1348 (build 211).
jin: holding final image tag until alex's approval on the extra nil check.
alex: pushed an extra commit to the PR to handle nil case, LGTM. approving.
maya: cutoff official — creating release tag after merge. Jin, please wait for final merge then publish image.
jin: merging now and tagging branch `hotfix/kv-shortseq-1.11.3`.
release-bot: :rocket: Deploy to canary started at 1902345690.
sam: canary smoke started; no obvious regressions after 5m. errors at 0.03% (baseline 0.02%) — watching.
ops_lead: if errors spike >0.5% roll back immediately. otherwise proceed to gradual.
alex: I see a transient routing error trace but it resolved after commit; looks like same nil case we fixed.
maya: good. ops_lead, start 25% rollout -> 100% over 15m when comfortable.
ops_lead: rolling out to 25% now. will monitor.
sam: latency p95 stable, CPU fine.
ops_lead: progressing to 100% at 15m mark.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary healthy. Rollout to 100% complete.
jin: pushed tag v1.11.3 and updated release notes: 'Fix: prevent double-free in KV cache for short sequences. No behavioral changes otherwise.'
maya: closing this hotpatch thread. great job all :tada: — add anything notable to the post-release notes if you saw oddness.
jin: noted small transient error during canary, added a note in the release ticket.
ops_lead: monitoring for next 1h, will escalate if we see anything.
release-bot: :package: Release v1.11.3 published.
maya: thanks everyone!
